description: End-to-end home network: Bell GigaHub fiber/WAN -> QNAP rack switch -> VyOS router/VLANs -> UniFi WiFi. Sources: gigahub-exporter, vyos-exporter, qss-exporter, unpoller.

targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_gpon_operational' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_ppp_up' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_ppp_uptime_seconds' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT max(v) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_default_route_present' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['family'], Attributes['table'])

SELECT sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_link_up' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['port'], Attributes['kind'], ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

SELECT toFloat64(uniqExact(tuple(Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']))) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_client_radio_signal_db' AND Attributes['wired'] = 'false' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_hosts_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_conntrack_entries' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'RX power' AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_optical_rx_power_dbm' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'TX power' AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_optical_tx_power_dbm' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'bias mA' AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_optical_bias_current_milliamps' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'SFP temp' AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_optical_temperature_celsius' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, direction, sum(d) / any(step) * 8 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['direction'] AS direction, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_ethernet_bytes_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND Attributes['interface'] = 'eth4' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time, direction

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat('errors ', Attributes['direction']) AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_optical_errors_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat('discards ', Attributes['reason']) AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'gigahub_optical_discards_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) * 8 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat(Attributes['interface'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_interface_bytes_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND Attributes['interface'] != 'lo' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, 'entries' AS series, sum(value) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_conntrack_entries' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, inst) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, 'limit' AS series, max(value) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_conntrack_limit' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, inst) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['pool'] AS pool, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_dhcp_leases' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND Attributes['state'] = 'active' GROUP BY time, pool ORDER BY time, pool

SELECT time, family, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['family'] AS family, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_firewall_drops_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time, family

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, 'alerts/s' AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_suricata_alerts_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, outcome, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['outcome'] AS outcome, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'vyos_dns_queries_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, outcome ORDER BY time, outcome

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) * 8 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat('p', Attributes['port'], ' rx') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_receive_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) * 8 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat('p', Attributes['port'], ' tx') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_transmit_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT concat('p', s.port) AS series, s.value AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['port'] AS port, Attributes['kind'] AS kind, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_speed_mbps' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY port, kind) AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['port'] AS port, Attributes['kind'] AS kind, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS up FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_link_up' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY port, kind) AS u ON s.port = u.port AND s.kind = u.kind WHERE u.up = 1 ORDER BY toInt32(s.port)

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat('p', Attributes['port'], ' fcs') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_fcs_errors' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(d) / any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat('p', Attributes['port'], ' rx-err') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_port_receive_errors' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat('p', Attributes['port']) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_sfp_temperature_celsius' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['sensor'] AS sensor, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_temperature_celsius' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, sensor ORDER BY time, sensor

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat('fan ', Attributes['fan']) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'qss_fan_rpm' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'clients' AS series, toFloat64(uniqExact(tuple(Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']))) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_client_radio_signal_db' AND Attributes['wired'] = 'false' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['name'] AS name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_client_radio_signal_db' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND Attributes['wired'] = 'false' GROUP BY time, name ORDER BY time, name

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['radio_name'] AS radio_desc, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_device_radio_channel_utilization_total_ratio' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, radio_desc ORDER BY time, radio_desc

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['name'], ' rx') AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_client_radio_receive_rate_bps' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND Attributes['wired'] = 'false' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['name'], ' tx') AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_client_radio_transmit_rate_bps' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND Attributes['wired'] = 'false' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'cpu' AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) / 100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_device_cpu_utilization_ratio' AND Attributes['type'] = 'uap' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'memory' AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) / 100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'unpoller_device_memory_utilization_ratio' AND Attributes['type'] = 'uap' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
